analysis.insight_summary: Users experience compatibility issues when trying to replace faulty expansion modules in their automation systems. Newer expansion modules cannot be used as substitutes for older models due to product version incompatibility. This restriction prevents mixing modules from different generations, leading to higher costs and potentially requiring hardware upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to replace older faulty expansion modules with newer products without having to upgrade the entire basic device.
